title: P007 two-vote wave 2: next 50 of the 290-row backlog + re-vote of the 6 convention rows under the shibh-jumla-mahall rule

scope.summary: Run the p007 two-vote process (entry b10a1ee04666) on the next 50 rows of the 340-row two-vote-required partition in canonical loc order, plus re-vote the 6 wave-1 convention-disagreement rows (2:130:17, 2:145:31, 2:198:25, 2:252:8, 3:164:23, 4:157:21) under the NEW worklist convention: when a non-governing lam sits on a bare-harf host whose shibh al-jumla carries a khabar role, encode the shibh al-jumla's MAHALL (raf3 under inna / nasb under kana) plus the nasikh governor — replacing wave-1's host-only rule (value none / governor null).
out_of_scope: the 2 substantive-arbitration rows from wave 1 (2:203:18 لِمَنِ attachment; 3:81:6 لَمَآ) — those await arbitration, NOT a re-vote
adopting the 22 wave-1 registry-key candidates (owner review)
any live-surface mutation or committed entry-state change

tools_required: mcp__tafsir__analyze_word (both vote lanes; independent call budgets, ~50+56 calls, cap 120)

a genuinely independent reviewer-B lane (separately spawned subagent that sees ONLY the sanitized worklist, the rows, the schema, and the registry — never reviewer-A's votes or this packet's expectations)
tools/validate_two_vote_artifacts.py (repo copy, invoked as the artifact gate)

commands.purpose: Derive the wave-2 worklist: first 50 rows in canonical loc order of the 340-row two-vote-required partition not covered by wave 1 (coverage manifest ref below), plus the 6 named convention re-vote rows
commands.expect: exactly 56 rows (50 fresh + 6 re-votes); missing exclusion manifest => STOP (escalation trigger 1)

commands.purpose: Author the wave-2 sanitized reviewer-B worklist: wave-1 shared_convention UPDATED with the shibh-jumla-mahall rule; rival-symmetric; controlled vocabulary only
commands.expect: worklist carries the new convention text under shared_convention.governor_rule and case_or_mood_rule; the old host-only rule is removed, not left ambiguous

commands.purpose: Vote lane A: independent votes with own MCP evidence
commands.expect: votes-a.jsonl + votes-a-mcp-calls.jsonl, one vote per row

commands.purpose: Vote lane B: spawn the independent reviewer with ONLY the sanitized worklist + rows + schema + registry
commands.run: run the reviewer-B lane per the worklist; collect votes-b.jsonl + votes-b-mcp-calls.jsonl
commands.expect: reviewer-B provenance records a distinct engine/reviewer id; zero exposure to lane-A votes

commands.purpose: Assemble v1.1 bundles, recompute agreement on conclusion + reason_key (never gloss text), then gate through the validator
commands.expect: 0 validator errors; disagreements become arbitration packets, never silent drops
facts certified only for two_vote_verified bundles; event trail valid

candidate_population.selection_rule: Sort the 340 two-vote-required rows by canonical loc (surah, ayah, word integers ascending); exclude the 50 wave-1 rows per the coverage manifest; take the first 50 remaining; append the 6 named convention re-vote rows (which stay counted against wave 1, not the 290). Deterministic and re-runnable.

expected_outputs.description: sanitized rival-symmetric worklist carrying the NEW shibh-jumla-mahall convention
independent lane-B votes + lane-B MCP evidence (votes-b-mcp-calls.jsonl)
agreement diff; every disagreement gets an arbitration packet row
hash-chained certification events for verified bundles
wave report: verified/disagreement counts split FRESH vs RE-VOTE, remaining backlog (290 - fresh-verified), convention-rule effectiveness (did the 6 re-votes converge?)

evidence_policy.statement: Token-layer i'rab conclusions certify ONLY through the two-vote artifact bundle (certification-authority ladder rung 4): two independent votes, distinct engines and reviewer ids, agreement computed on conclusion + reason_key, never on gloss text. Each lane gathers its own surface-matched MCP evidence. The re-vote rows must record that they are re-votes under a changed convention, citing the wave-1 arbitration packets.
evidence_policy.fabrication_rule: Votes are never fabricated, copied between lanes, or backfilled (votes_fabricated must be false and true in fact). A missing lane-B vote leaves the row two_vote_claimed_unverified at best — it never certifies. Evidence gaps are recorded, not papered over.

guards: The METHOD transfers; conclusions never do: reviewer-B's worklist states conventions and controlled vocabulary, never expected answers; the 6 re-vote rows must not be told wave-1's vote contents beyond the published convention change.

The new shibh-jumla-mahall rule is an ENCODING convention, not a grammatical verdict: it changes how agreed grammar is written into compared fields (mahall + nasikh governor instead of none/null); any row where the reviewers disagree on the GRAMMAR still routes to arbitration.
Agreement is computed on conclusion + reason_key with gloss_text_used_for_agreement false — a gloss-text match proves nothing.
Candidate lane mode: new files under qamus/certification/p007-twovote-w2/ only.
No private corpus names or server paths in any output (FORBIDDEN_LABELS / RM-09).
defeaters: Convention-encoding mismatch (the wave-1 6-row class): identical lam identity + reason_key + attachment_key but divergent case/governor encoding on a bare-harf host in a khabar-role shibh al-jumla — under this packet the mahall encoding is the rule; a residual mismatch after the rule is applied is a REAL disagreement and routes to arbitration.
Substantive attachment divergence (model: 2:203:18): reviewers disagree on what the lam attaches to — arbitration packet, never averaged.
Muwatti'a/shart lam (model: 3:81:6 لَمَآ): host-mahall scope rule is still OPEN (wave-1 defect 5.3); rows of this shape route to arbitration with the question recorded, they are not voted through.

Registry-key gap: a needed function/attachment/reason key missing from reason-key-registry.jsonl is recorded as a registry-extension candidate; the registry file itself is never edited by this packet.

positive.expectation: two independent votes converge on harf-jarr-lam-fused with matching reason_key; bundle reaches two_vote_verified (this exact bundle exists as a committed canary)
under the new mahall rule both lanes now encode the shibh al-jumla's mahall + nasikh governor and the row converges to two_vote_verified — this is the rule's acceptance proof

adversarial.expectation: MUST NOT be re-voted or certified by this packet (substantive + open scope rule); if it appears in the worklist selection is broken — STOP and escalate
MUST NOT be re-voted (substantive attachment arbitration pending); appearing in the worklist is a selection defect — STOP and escalate

acceptance_tests.name: worklist determinism + exclusions
acceptance_tests.run: re-run selection to a temp file; diff; grep for 3:81:6 and 2:203:18
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: byte-identical re-run; neither arbitration row present

acceptance_tests.name: artifact gate
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: exit 0, 0 errors, one bundle per worklist row

acceptance_tests.name: independence audit
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: distinct reviewer ids + engines on every bundle; lane-B MCP calls disjoint from lane-A logs

acceptance_tests.name: event trail valid
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: exit 0 and 'OK: certification event trail is valid'

acceptance_tests.name: no unauthorized writes
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: changes only under the two permitted paths

non_deployment.statement: Candidate lane mode throughout: bundles and certifications live in the wave-2 lane store only; no live surface, whitelist row, committed entry state, or registry file is mutated. Deploy of any resulting fact is a separate owner-gated decision.

conditions: the wave-1 coverage manifest or arbitration packets are unavailable (selection and re-vote context cannot be established)
either adversarial canary row appears in the generated worklist
a re-vote row still disagrees after the mahall rule is applied (rule insufficient — needs arbitration, possibly owner)
reviewer-B independence is compromised in any way (shared context, seen votes, same engine identity)
more than 10 of the 50 fresh rows disagree (systematic convention gap like wave 1's — stop and fix the worklist before burning MCP budget)
escalation_trigger.route: STOP the wave; write the stop-report into qamus/reports/p007-twovote-w2.md and emit arbitration packet rows into the lane store; hand back to the Fusha certifier lane / owner arbitration process

definition_of_done: 56-row worklist committed (50 fresh + 6 marked re-votes), deterministic
wave-2 reviewer-B worklist committed carrying the explicit shibh-jumla-mahall convention
two vote files + two MCP evidence files committed, independence auditable
all bundles pass tools/validate_two_vote_artifacts.py; diff report + arbitration packets committed
verified bundles certified; event trail validates
wave report separates fresh vs re-vote outcomes and states the remaining backlog (290 - fresh rows completed)
all five acceptance tests pass; zero writes outside permitted paths
